_: 전투 배경 생성 프롬프트. 공통 제약은 common 에, 지역별 차이는 zones[].scene 에만 둔다. 생성 후 실제로 쓴 모델/설정과 결과를 generated 에 기록할 것.

common.style: 2D mobile idle RPG battle background, side view, cute cartoon style with thick clean outlines, flat shading, high saturation, bright and readable
common.composition: Horizontal 9:5 banner. Clear horizon line at 70% from the top: everything below is the ground the characters stand on, everything above is sky/backdrop. Depth in three layers: far backdrop, mid silhouettes, near foreground details along the bottom edge.
common.constraints: Leave the center and right-center area visually calm and uncluttered — characters stand there. No characters, no creatures, no text, no letters, no UI elements, no borders, no watermark. Even lighting, no strong vignette.
common.negative: characters, people, monsters, text, letters, numbers, UI, HUD, buttons, frames, watermark, signature, dark gloomy mood, heavy vignette, busy center
